[RTIM.14.6] **Stub answering.** For each outbound `call`, the interpreter answers
from the matching `TestResponse` stub: it asserts the stub's `TestReply` reply facts —
immediately (same instant, `after_ns = 0`) or scheduled for delivery at
`call_time + after_ns` ([LTSL.7.4]) — or nothing for `no_response`. **Replies due
at the same instant are delivered in call order** — the order the outbound calls
were issued — so the input stream is deterministic ([RTIM.14.5]). An outbound
call with no matching `TestResponse` **must fail the test case** ([LTSL.7.6]); the
interpreter must not treat it as a silent no-op.
